title: Incredibly knowledge, friendly, and wonderufl tour guide
text:
Sophia is an incredible tour guide and surpassed all of our (already high) expectations!!  I bought the private tour for my mother for her birthday.  Before the tour, Sophia made herself available via WhatsApp to provide general advice about Seville, what to do, what to see, where to shop, etc.  She had already impressed us before even meeting her.  

Sophia showed up early to our hotel the day of the tour and is a delight in person.  Very affable, funny, and knowledgeable.  She answered all of our questions comprehensively, and also made the tour interactive and more memorable by also asking
author: P9877ZZalext

title: Tour of Cathedral
text: Sofia did an amazing job. She was interesting, friendly, and very informative. I would recommend her to anyone looking for a good tour guide!
